value.name: Charlene rejects Micky
value.description: Charlene tells Micky he cannot treat them that way, signaling a breakup in their relationship.
evidence: CHARLENE You can't do that to us.

value.name: Micky accuses Charlene of siding with others
value.description: Micky responds that Charlene now sounds like the people he resents, deepening the conflict.
evidence: MICKY You sound like them now.

value.name: Charlene tells Micky he belongs elsewhere
value.description: Charlene suggests Micky is like the people he blames and belongs with them instead of with her.
evidence: CHARLENE Maybe you're just like them and that's where you belong.

value.name: Charlene leaves the gym
value.description: Charlene turns and walks out of the gym, ending the confrontation.
evidence: She looks at him, turns and walks out of the gym

value.name: O'Keefe follows Charlene out
value.description: O'Keefe leaves with Charlene but looks back sadly at Micky as he goes.
evidence: followed by O'Keefe, who looks sadly back at Micky.

value.name: Alice reassures Micky
value.description: Alice tries to comfort Micky by saying the situation may be for the best.
evidence: ALICE Everything happens for a reason, this could be for the best, honey.

value.name: Micky watches Dicky gear up
value.description: Micky observes Dicky being outfitted with boxing gear before the sparring session.
evidence: Micky watches Dicky get geared up with gloves, headgear, mouth guard by Art Ramalho.

value.name: Dicky is praised as Lowell's pride
value.description: Ray Ramalho publicly hails Dicky as the pride of Lowell, which irritates Micky.
evidence: RAY RAMALHO Dicky Ecklund, the pride a Lowell! This rankles Micky

value.name: Micky and Dicky square off
value.description: Micky and Dicky face each other in the ring, preparing to spar as others watch.
evidence: The two brothers spar, falling right back into it as Alice, George, others watch.

value.name: Dicky boasts about jail training
value.description: Dicky says he trained in jail and is ready to fight, showing confidence and bravado.
evidence: DICKY I was trainin' in jail, so I'm ready.

value.name: Brothers spar aggressively
value.description: Micky and Dicky trade blows and clinches, quickly reverting to their familiar combative dynamic.
evidence: The two brothers spar, falling right back into it

Dicky moving around the ring... He snaps Micky's head with a combination. Micky starts banging him with body shots...Bam! Bam! Bam!...Dicky tries to make Micky miss. Micky grabs him tying him up.. .Dicky pushes Micky away, ducks, jabs.. .Micky traps Dicky's left under his elbow/arm, pulling it.
